title: Combat Power Check: Kaiju No. 8 True or False
description: Ten statements on the manga, its run, the suits, the influences and the awards. Some are one detail off, so read closely.

questions.question: Naoya Matsumoto is both writer and artist of the manga, which ran on Shueisha's Shōnen Jump+ from July 3, 2020 until July 18, 2025.
The manga closed after 129 chapters collected in 26 volumes, with the final book reaching Japanese shops on September 4, 2025.
The manga closed after 129 chapters collected in 16 volumes, with the final book reaching Japanese shops on September 4, 2025.
Officers fight in powered suits built from kaiju remains, and each suit shows a combat power percentage that tops out at 200.
Officers fight in powered suits built from kaiju remains, and each suit shows a combat power percentage that tops out at 100.
Naoya Matsumoto is both writer and artist of the manga, which ran on Shueisha's Weekly Shōnen Jump from July 3, 2020 until July 18, 2025.
Matsumoto drew on Japanese tokusatsu shows, above all the Ultraman series.
The manga took the 2021 Next Manga Award for web manga and won an Eisner Award the year after.
